name: k8s datastore — API server datastore request latency p99 exceeds 1 s over 5 min
description: Fires when P99(etcd_request_duration_seconds) over the trailing 5 min exceeds 1 second. Under kine this histogram measures the SQL round trip, so it is the slow-SQL stall (Slow SQL: INSERT INTO kine in the k3s journal) visible before a run fails. If Honeycomb cannot take P99 on the OTLP histogram, replace the calculation with the share of requests in buckets at or above 1 s. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.sh (1-min timer, livespec-dev-tooling-vdleg7). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; ssh poweredge-xubuntu; kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'; journalctl -u k3s --since -30min; df -h /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
